items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: go overseas with Bob Hope with his Christmas Show, which I made three trips over there with him

ctx.x: It gave me an opportunity, the setup. If I played -- go down and play the Hollywood Palace and you see me, that's how you found out that I was the one, but they set me up for Bob Hope while I was overseas. I told you Mrs. whatsname set me up for that, 'cause she played my (inaudible) for

West Command. She did my whole act for him. That' set me up for Bob Hope whenever he heard it, or whenever somebody told him about me. She'd be looking for me. They saw me in the vaudeville theaters, I've been on the stage long enough. I created enough understanding in the business. I don't have to get with nobody. They see me, I'm perfectly figured. They can see me on the stage. That's where the people get all the people for shows or something, they go all around in different theaters where they're playing or…
